library(metafor)
library(jsonlite)
a<-commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
d<-read.csv(a[1])
m<-rma(yi=yi,vi=vi,data=d,method="REML",test="knha")
p<-predict(m)
write_json(list(estimate=as.numeric(m$b),se=m$se,ci_lower=m$ci.lb,ci_upper=m$ci.ub,p_value=m$pval,tau2=m$tau2,I2=m$I2,k=m$k,prediction_lower=p$pi.lb,prediction_upper=p$pi.ub,metafor_version=as.character(packageVersion("metafor")),method="REML with Knapp-Hartung inference"),a[2],auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE,digits=16)
